events.label: Reddit (RDDT) joins S&P 500 — passive demand concentrated at Aug 17 closing auction
events.note: Updated Aug 17 morning: RDDT at ~$177.56 pre-market (flat from $178.09 Friday close). The Aug 17 closing auction is today — JPMorgan estimates ~16.7M shares (~8% of diluted float, ~3x average daily volume) in passive MOC buying. Post-mechanics test (Aug 18–19 closes): hold above $177 for two sessions = fundamental demand (advertising durability in AI-search environment) supports the passive bid. Reversion below $158 (pre-announcement close) within two sessions = purely mechanical pop. SPCX Nasdaq-100 inclusion precedent (July): mechanical gains can unwind substantially without fundamental support.

events.label: SPCX next staggered tranche (~7%) — second unlock after Aug 6 first tranche
events.note: Updated Aug 17 morning: SPCX ~$140.00 pre-market (day range $135.50–$144.02). August 20 tranche (3 days). September hike odds at 30%; 30Y at 5.27% (1bp from trigger). Oil triggers still active: WTI $82.32 (above $79), Brent $88.31 (above $85). Front-run signal: close below $120 on elevated volume before Aug 20. Morgan Stanley $140, Bernstein $248, Citi $200 targets. October Q3 earnings (Starlink profitability) is the fundamental narrative anchor. Hormuz ceasefire expires today — oil escalation risk is the blocking condition for rate-compression thesis.

events.label: NVDA Q2 FY27 earnings (est.) — three altitude ceiling sector confirmations raise the bar
events.note: Updated Aug 17 morning: NVDA ~$226 pre-market. Anthropic Q2 revenue ($11.5B, +14x YoY, first adjusted operating profit) is the most direct AI capex validation before this print — it confirms AI application-layer revenue is real and scaling. The altitude ceiling still spans three AI infrastructure sectors: CSCO, AMAT, and AVGO (all delivered at-or-near estimates and declined). The bar for August 26: gross margin above 78% AND data-center guide materially above the most aggressive sell-side estimate — both simultaneously. September hike odds 30%, 30Y at 5.27% (1bp from trigger). Jackson Hole begins Aug 27 — no de-risk window between the print and Warsh's keynote.

events.label: Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium (Aug 27–29) — Warsh keynote; September odds at 30%
events.note: Updated Aug 17 morning: September hike odds at 30% after five consecutive soft data prints (NFP −23K, CPI core 2.5%, PPI flat, retail sales −0.6% MoM, UMich prelim 51.0 vs 54.5). 30Y at 5.27%, 1bp from the 5.28% regime trigger. Hormuz ceasefire expired today — escalation risk adds oil-shock scenario before Warsh speaks. UMich final (due Aug 28, during Jackson Hole) is a within-symposium data point. Dovish Warsh message compresses 30Y toward 5.10% and September odds below 20%. Hawkish message (SPR at 40-year lows, Hormuz disruption, UMich inflation expectations elevated) re-anchors 30Y above 5.28%. NVDA earnings land Aug 26 — one day before the keynote, no de-risk window. FOMC Minutes (July 28–29 meeting, three hawkish dissenters) land Wed Aug 19 and may preview the internal debate Warsh inherited.

events.label: AVGO Q3 FY2026 earnings (est.) — VMware liability and AI concentration: first post-exploitation read
events.note: Added Aug 14 night: AVGO fell 4.1% to $389.79 on August 14 on two simultaneous headwinds: VMware CVE-2026-59310 active exploitation (361 IPs, 47 countries) and guidance implying AI accounts for ~72% of next-quarter sequential revenue growth. Q3 FY2026 results (est. early September, approximately September 4-5 based on Q2 reporting June 3) are the first public accounting of both: whether VMware remediation costs appear in the financial guidance, whether enterprise customers cited the incident, and whether AI revenue breadth (or concentration) shifts the multiple conversation. At ~65x trailing P/E, any miss or margin compression compounds. The $380 structural support level and $400 resistance are the two levels to monitor heading into the print.

events.label: SPCX 180-day IPO lock-up expiry (approx.) — terminal insider/early-investor float unlock
events.note: ~180 days after the June 12 debut. Lock-up expiries are the known supply overhang for hot IPOs. Context after Aug 6-7: 20% first tranche absorbed at $105-$115; next tranches scheduled Aug 20 and late September. Q3 Starlink profitability (~October call) is the only fundamental catalyst that could revalue the lockup discount before the December terminal release. SPCX Q2: $18.37B capex vs $7.81B revenue; AI segment $2.56B (+247% YoY).

events.label: OpenAI IPO — target window H1 2027 after 2026 delay
events.note: OpenAI delayed its anticipated 2026 IPO to H1 2027 (announced June 26, 2026). PLTR's 149% US commercial growth, AMD's $6.7B data-center (+107%), and SpaceX's exclusive Nvidia commitment ($15.83B AI capex) confirm the enterprise AI adoption underlying OpenAI's revenue model. NVDA circular financing disclosure ($250B OpenAI backstop) remains the unresolved structural question that may surface in S-1 filings.
